text: I can choose between a counter, gauge, histogram and summary for a given measurement and write the matching Prometheus query.
I can estimate a p99 from cumulative histogram buckets the way histogram_quantile does, and explain why percentiles must not be averaged.
I can list the RED metrics for a service and the USE checks for its resources, and use them together to go from symptom to bottleneck.
I can compute the series count of a metric as the product of its label cardinalities, including histogram buckets.
I can diagnose and prevent a cardinality explosion with label allow-lists, relabelling, sample limits and an alert on active series.
